name: Bare mode for scripted runs
what: --bare skips hooks, skills, plugins, MCP, auto memory and CLAUDE.md so scripted -p calls start fast and identically everywhere.
why_for_gordon: Darby's launchd jobs on the Mac Mini get deterministic, faster runs without dragging in Gordon's whole interactive setup.
how: claude --bare -p "Summarize README.md" --allowedTools "Read" (set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; bare mode ignores subscription login)

name: Structured JSON output with a schema
what: --json-schema forces the final answer into validated JSON, with metadata in the wrapper and data in structured_output.
why_for_gordon: Darby pipelines (triage, rosters, care ledger) can parse Claude output reliably instead of regexing prose.
how: claude -p "..." --output-format json --json-schema '{"type":"object",...}' | jq '.structured_output'

name: Unattended runs: --permission-prompts none
what: Denies anything that would prompt, tells Claude not to retry, and removes AskUserQuestion so scheduled jobs never hang.
why_for_gordon: Overnight Darby jobs and the Astra watcher stop stalling on a prompt nobody is there to answer.
how: claude -p "..." --permission-mode auto --permission-prompts none (v2.1.259+); or --permission-mode dontAsk for locked-down CI

name: Fable and the best alias
what: fable selects Fable 5.1 for long autonomous work; best picks Fable where available, otherwise Opus.
why_for_gordon: Big site builds and semester-long course prep get the model that verifies its own work and sustains long sessions.
how: claude --model fable or /model best; consent prompt appears if it bills usage credits

name: Auto mode permission
what: A classifier model reviews actions instead of prompting; it blocks escalation, unrecognized infrastructure, and hostile-content-driven actions.
why_for_gordon: Removes the tap-tap-tap of approvals during long site builds while still stopping rm -rf and secret leaks.
how: claude --permission-mode auto; Shift+Tab cycles to auto; built-in start mode on Pro, Max, Team

name: Generate auto mode environment entries
what: /auto-mode-setup scans your project, git remotes, and recent sessions to draft trusted-infrastructure entries into user settings.
why_for_gordon: Teaches the classifier that gbellamy repos, GitHub Pages, and Darby's hosts are trusted so routine pushes stop getting blocked.
how: /auto-mode-setup (Pro, Max, Team; v2.1.228+), then claude auto-mode config

name: Human checkpoint inside auto mode
what: permissions.ask rules are evaluated before the classifier and always prompt, even in auto mode.
why_for_gordon: Keep auto mode on but require Gordon's nod before any git push or PR to a public GGP repo.
how: {"permissions":{"ask":["Bash(git push *)","Bash(gh pr create *)"]}}

name: /goal keeps working until a condition holds
what: A small model checks your completion condition after each turn and Claude keeps going until met, impossible, or cleared.
why_for_gordon: Set "all Pages builds pass and no em dashes remain" and walk away; works headless and over Remote Control.
how: /goal <condition> ; /goal shows status; /goal clear; claude -p "/goal ..." --output-format stream-json --verbose

name: /loop on a fixed or self-paced interval
what: Re-runs a prompt or skill every N minutes, or lets Claude choose the delay; Esc stops a self-paced loop.
why_for_gordon: Poll the imsg relay, watch Astra's drop folder, or re-run /astra-daily every 20 minutes inside one session.
how: /loop 5m check the deploy ; /loop check whether CI passed ; /loop 20m /review-pr 1234 ; 'remind me at 3pm to ...' creates a one-shot

name: Cloud routines from /schedule
what: Create routines that run on Anthropic infrastructure on a cron, once, via API POST, or on GitHub events.
why_for_gordon: GGP's weekly digest or a Monday board refresh runs even when the Mini is off; one-offs do not count toward the daily cap.
how: /schedule daily PR review at 9am ; /schedule tomorrow at 9am, ... ; /schedule list|update|run ; GitHub trigger via CLI needs v2.1.225+

name: Desktop local scheduled tasks
what: Claude Desktop runs local tasks on a schedule with file access, per-task permission mode, missed-run catch-up, and worktree isolation.
why_for_gordon: Morning brief and care ledger jobs on the Mini with local files, replacing fragile launchd plists.
how: Desktop Code tab, Routines, New routine, Local; or say 'set up a daily code review at 9am' in a session; edit ~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/<name>/SKILL.md

name: Agent view for background sessions
what: claude agents shows all background sessions grouped by state, with dispatch input, peek panel, and attach.
why_for_gordon: One screen to run Darby's triage, a site build, and an Astra exchange in parallel.
how: claude agents ; claude --bg "prompt" ; claude agents --permission-mode plan --model opus

name: Channels: push iMessage or Telegram into a live session
what: A channel plugin pushes messages into your running session and Claude replies through the same platform.
why_for_gordon: This is Darby's iMessage relay as a first-party feature: text yourself, Claude answers, with an allowlist gate.
how: /plugin install imessage@claude-plugins-official ; claude --channels plugin:imessage@claude-plugins-official ; /imessage:access allow +1555...

name: Auto-continue after a usage limit
what: When a claude.ai limit hits mid-task, Claude Code waits and resumes the task itself when the window resets.
why_for_gordon: A long overnight build survives Gordon's weekly limit without babysitting.
how: On by default (v2.1.234+); /rate-limit-options to start or cancel; autoContinueAtUsageLimit=false to disable

name: Remote Control from phone or browser
what: Expose a local session to claude.ai or the Claude app; QR code for the phone; execution stays on your machine.
why_for_gordon: Gordon steers Darby on the Mini from his phone at a festival or between classes.
how: claude remote-control (press Space for QR) ; claude --rc "My Project" ; /rc inside a session

name: Dynamic workflows and /deep-research
what: Claude writes a JavaScript script that fans out dozens of subagents; /deep-research is the bundled cited-report workflow.
why_for_gordon: Cross-checked research for a course reading list or a festival dossier, saved as a reusable /command.
how: /deep-research <question> ; ultracode: <task> in a prompt ; /workflows then s to save ; /config workflowSizeGuideline=small

name: Dollar cap per run
what: --max-budget-usd stops a print-mode run once estimated API spend crosses the amount.
why_for_gordon: A runaway Darby cron job cannot burn through GGP's budget while Gordon sleeps.
how: claude -p "..." --max-budget-usd 2.00

name: Resume a session by ID from any directory
what: claude -p --resume <id> finds the session anywhere on the machine, or accepts an absolute .jsonl transcript path.
why_for_gordon: Darby can keep one long-running conversation per project across separate launchd invocations.
how: session_id=$(claude -p "Start" --output-format json | jq -r .session_id); claude -p "Continue" --resume "$session_id"

name: Slash commands inside -p prompts
what: Skills and value-taking commands (/model sonnet, /effort, /fast, /config key=value) expand inside a -p prompt string.
why_for_gordon: Scheduled Darby jobs can pin model and effort per run, or invoke a skill like /astra-daily headlessly.
how: claude -p "/model sonnet /config thinking=false Summarize this" (v2.1.205+)

name: Fallback model chain
what: Up to three fallback models kick in when the primary is overloaded, set per session or in settings.
why_for_gordon: Darby's timed sends never fail because Opus was busy at 7am.
how: claude --fallback-model sonnet,haiku or "fallbackModel": ["claude-sonnet-5","claude-haiku-4-5"]

name: Effort levels and the ultrathink keyword
what: /effort sets low to max (xhigh on newer models); ultrathink in a prompt triggers one-off deep reasoning without changing the level.
why_for_gordon: Cheap effort for Darby's routine triage, xhigh for the CTIN 463 syllabus or a board deck.
how: /effort high; claude --effort xhigh; CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL; modelSettings per model in settings

name: Ultracode effort
what: ultracode combines xhigh reasoning with automatic dynamic-workflow orchestration for every substantive task in the session.
why_for_gordon: When Gordon wants a whole site audit or a 100-file rebuild planned and fanned out without babysitting.
how: /effort ultracode, claude --effort ultracode, or "ultracode": true in settings (v2.1.203+)

name: Tune the auto-compact window
what: Set how full the context gets before compaction, per session or saved, from 100K to 1M tokens.
why_for_gordon: Long Darby sessions on Sonnet 5's 1M window can compact earlier to stay cheap and cache-friendly.
how: /autocompact 500k, claude --autocompact 750k, CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=500k, or "autoCompactWindow" (v2.1.221+)

name: Trusted infrastructure with $defaults
what: autoMode.environment lists prose entries for trusted repos, buckets, domains; "$defaults" splices in the built-ins.
why_for_gordon: Name GGP's GitHub org and Pages domains once so the classifier treats them as inside the boundary.
how: ~/.claude/settings.json: {"autoMode":{"environment":["$defaults","Source control: github.com/gbellamy ..."]}}

name: Inspect and critique classifier rules
what: claude auto-mode subcommands print built-in rules, your effective config, AI critique of custom rules, or reset to defaults.
why_for_gordon: Darby can audit exactly what the classifier will block before Gordon trusts it with unattended runs.
how: claude auto-mode defaults [--label 'Git Destructive']; claude auto-mode config; claude auto-mode critique; claude auto-mode reset --yes

name: Review and retry auto mode denials
what: /permissions has a Recently denied tab (press r to retry) and an Auto mode tab to edit allow, soft_deny, hard_deny, environment.
why_for_gordon: When the classifier blocks a legitimate Pages deploy, fix the rule in the dialog rather than a settings file.
how: /permissions, Recently denied tab, r; Auto mode tab (v2.1.246+)

name: Spoken boundaries the classifier enforces
what: Saying "don't push until I review" in conversation becomes a block signal the classifier honors until you lift it.
why_for_gordon: Gordon can set a guardrail in plain English mid-session without touching config.
how: Type the boundary in chat; for a durable guarantee add a deny or ask rule since compaction can drop it

name: Plan mode entry and exit shortcuts
what: /plan enters plan mode from the prompt; accepting a plan offers "Yes, and use auto mode" and auto-titles the session.
why_for_gordon: Plan a syllabus rewrite or a GGP site change, review it, then let auto mode execute.
how: /plan <description>; claude --permission-mode plan; Shift+Tab cycles; useAutoModeDuringPlan is on by default

name: Comment on a permission answer
what: Press Tab on a permission prompt to attach a comment that Claude reads with your yes or no.
why_for_gordon: Gordon can say "yes but only the draft, never send" at the exact moment it matters.
how: On a permission prompt press Tab, type the note, then answer

name: Auto-build an allowlist from transcripts
what: /fewer-permission-prompts scans past sessions for read-only Bash and MCP calls and writes a prioritized allowlist.
why_for_gordon: Cuts Darby's interruption rate in Manual mode without hand-writing dozens of rules.
how: /fewer-permission-prompts (writes to project .claude/settings.json)

name: Built-in Concise and Proactive output styles
what: Concise leads with the result and trims narration; Proactive acts on assumptions instead of pausing for routine decisions.
why_for_gordon: Concise matches Gordon's terse Joe-voice replies; Proactive suits unattended Darby builds.
how: /config, Output style, or "outputStyle": "Concise" (Concise needs v2.1.237+); /output-style [name] returned in 2.1.269 for headless and Remote Control

name: Custom output style that keeps coding instructions
what: A Markdown file with frontmatter sets Claude's role and tone; keep-coding-instructions: true retains the engineering defaults.
why_for_gordon: Gordon's gordon-voice style (no em dashes, LYMI sign-off) as a style file, not a repeated prompt.
how: ~/.claude/output-styles/gordon-voice.md with name, description, keep-coding-instructions frontmatter; select via /config

name: Rate limit and prompt cache fields in the status line
what: Scripts receive rate_limits.five_hour and seven_day percentages plus a prompt_cache object with warm state and hit ratio.
why_for_gordon: Gordon sees his weekly limit and whether the cache is warm before starting an expensive turn.
how: Read rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage and prompt_cache.warm from stdin JSON (prompt_cache v2.1.251+)

name: loop.md default maintenance prompt
what: A project or user loop.md replaces the built-in maintenance prompt that bare /loop runs.
why_for_gordon: Darby's standing housekeeping list (backups, ledger, watch log) becomes the default loop body.
how: .claude/loop.md or ~/.claude/loop.md; edits apply next iteration; bare /loop runs it

name: Fire a routine from any script
what: Each routine can get a bearer-token /fire endpoint; POST optional text that arrives wrapped as untrusted payload.
why_for_gordon: Darby's launchd or the Astra watcher can kick a cloud routine when a file lands, with no session open.
how: curl -X POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/claude_code/routines/<id>/fire -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -H 'anthropic-beta: experimental-cc-routine-2026-04-01' -d '{"text":"..."}'

name: Setup checkup with fixes
what: /doctor diagnoses invalid settings, duplicate agents, unused extensions, and proposes CLAUDE.md trims; claude doctor is the read-only CLI form.
why_for_gordon: Keeps Darby's sprawling ~/.claude healthy and the memory index under its size budget.
how: /doctor (alias /checkup; CLAUDE.md trim needs v2.1.206+) ; claude doctor

name: Safe mode to isolate a broken config
what: --safe-mode starts with all customizations off (CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, hooks, MCP) while auth and tools work.
why_for_gordon: First move when Darby misbehaves after a settings change.
how: claude --safe-mode ; for a fully clean run: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/claude-clean claude

name: Import config from Codex, Gemini CLI, or Cursor
what: /import copies instruction files into CLAUDE.md and carries over MCP servers, commands, subagents, and skills.
why_for_gordon: Pull Astra's Codex configuration into Darby so the two agents share tools.
how: /import codex --dry-run ; /import cursor (v2.1.265+) ; claude import codex

name: Background or fork the current session
what: /background frees the terminal while the session keeps running; /fork copies the conversation into a new background session.
why_for_gordon: Start a long GGP directory build, background it, keep chatting in a fork.
how: /background (alias /bg) ; /fork [prompt] (v2.1.212+) ; press Left arrow on an empty prompt

name: Manage background sessions from the shell
what: attach, logs, stop, respawn, rm, and daemon subcommands control the supervisor and its sessions; --json lists state.
why_for_gordon: Darby scripts can check what is running and restart stuck workers without a UI.
how: claude attach <id> ; claude logs <id> ; claude respawn --all ; claude agents --json --all ; claude daemon status

name: Message your other sessions
what: ListAgents and SendMessage let one session warn or brief another; @-mention a live session by name in your prompt.
why_for_gordon: Darby and a second worker session coordinate on the same repo without Gordon copy-pasting.
how: Let @api-worker know the migration finished (v2.1.232+) ; /list-agents ; crossSessionInbound accept|hold|refuse

name: /skill-doctor prunes unused skills
what: Shows what each loaded skill costs in context and how often it is used so you can turn some off.
why_for_gordon: Gordon's 100-skill trial left dead weight; this names it.
how: /skill-doctor (v2.1.252+, needs feature-flag fetching)

name: /usage attribution breakdown
what: Shows what counts against plan limits by skill, subagent, plugin, MCP server, behavior flags, and heavy /loop tasks.
why_for_gordon: Find out whether the Astra watcher or a chatty MCP server is eating Gordon's week.
how: /usage then press d or w for 24h or 7d; Loops rows need v2.1.242+

name: /insights session report
what: Analyzes up to 200 recent sessions and writes an HTML report on friction points and better usage.
why_for_gordon: Feeds Darby's weekly reflection with data instead of vibes.
how: /insights ; report at ~/.claude/usage-data/report.html

name: Rewind menu with partial summaries
what: /rewind or double Esc restores code, conversation, or both, or summarizes from or up to a chosen message; includes a resume-previous-session entry after /clear.
why_for_gordon: Undo a bad site edit without losing the plan, or compress a debugging detour in place.
how: /rewind ; Esc Esc on empty input ; 'Summarize from here' with optional focus text ; '/resume <id> (previous session)' row (v2.1.191+)

name: Resume from a summary
what: Resuming a large, hour-old session offers to compact first so later requests carry a summary, not the whole history.
why_for_gordon: Darby's multi-day project sessions stop re-billing 100K tokens on every morning message.
how: Pick 'Resume from summary' in the dialog on Pro or Max; 'Don't ask me again' to suppress

name: Name, find, and filter sessions
what: Name at launch or with /rename, resume by name, and filter the picker by project, worktree, branch, or PR URL.
why_for_gordon: Darby's dozens of sessions become findable: --resume astra-daily instead of scrolling.
how: claude -n auth-refactor ; /rename ; claude --resume <name> ; picker Ctrl+A / Ctrl+W / Ctrl+B ; claude --from-pr 1234

name: Isolated worktree per session
what: --worktree creates .claude/worktrees/<name> on its own branch; .worktreeinclude copies gitignored files like .env into it.
why_for_gordon: Run two Darby sessions on the openclaw repo without edits colliding.
how: claude --worktree feature-auth ; .worktreeinclude with .env ; "worktree":{"baseRef":"head"}

name: Remote Control on every session
what: Turn on auto-connect so each interactive session registers itself; settings key remoteControlAtStartup.
why_for_gordon: Darby is always reachable without remembering the flag.
how: /config, Enable Remote Control for all sessions ; "remoteControlAtStartup": true in ~/.claude/settings.json

name: Mobile push when Claude decides
what: With Remote Control active, the phone gets pushes when a task finishes or needs a decision; you can ask for one in the prompt.
why_for_gordon: "Notify me when the brief is sent" reaches Gordon's phone without an iMessage relay.
how: /config, Push when Claude decides and Push when actions required ; prompt: notify me when the tests finish

name: Remote Control server with worktree spawning
what: Server mode serves many sessions; --spawn worktree gives each remote session its own worktree, --capacity caps them.
why_for_gordon: Dispatch several GGP tasks from the phone, each isolated, all on the Mini.
how: claude remote-control --spawn worktree --capacity 8 --permission-mode acceptEdits ; --continue to bring sessions back

name: Send work to the cloud from the terminal
what: --cloud starts a new claude.ai/code session from your repo; multiple calls run in parallel; /tasks tracks them.
why_for_gordon: Offload the long CTIN 463 site build to the cloud and keep the Mini free for Darby.
how: claude --cloud "Fix the auth bug" ; /web-setup to grant GitHub via your gh token ; CCR_FORCE_BUNDLE=1 for repos with no remote

name: Steer a cloud session from any shell
what: claude -p "message" --cloud <session-id> queues one message into a running cloud session and exits.
why_for_gordon: Darby's watcher can nudge a cloud build when Astra drops a file.
how: claude -p "run the tests again" --cloud session_01... --output-format json

name: Teleport a cloud session to your terminal
what: --teleport or /teleport fetches the branch and full conversation into a local session.
why_for_gordon: Finish a cloud-started GGP task locally with Darby's MCP servers and files.
how: claude --teleport [session-id] ; /teleport or /tp ; /tasks then t

name: Auto-fix pull requests
what: /autofix-pr spawns a web session that watches the branch's PR and pushes fixes when CI fails or reviewers comment.
why_for_gordon: Set it on a GGP site PR and let the failing Pages check fix itself while Gordon teaches.
how: /autofix-pr [prompt] on the PR branch; needs the Claude GitHub App

name: Desktop parallel sessions with worktrees
what: Cmd+N opens sessions side by side, a worktree toggle isolates each, Cmd-click shows two panes, Cmd+Shift+B opens a Browser pane.
why_for_gordon: Build and preview a site in one window while Darby runs triage in another.
how: Claude Desktop, Code tab: Cmd+N, worktree option next to branch, Cmd+Shift+B ; /desktop from the CLI moves a session over

name: Fullscreen renderer with mouse
what: /tui fullscreen relaunches into a flicker-free alt-screen with mouse scroll, click-to-expand, in-app selection, and transcript search.
why_for_gordon: Long Darby sessions in tmux stop flashing; scroll back through compactions.
how: /tui fullscreen ; CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 ; /focus for prompt-plus-answer view ; /scroll-speed ; Ctrl+O then / to search

name: Side questions with /btw
what: Ask about the current session without adding to history; f forks the answer into a tool-enabled subagent.
why_for_gordon: "What was that file called" without a token-heavy turn; fork when it turns into real work.
how: /btw what was the config file name? ; keys: c copy, f fork, x clear, Shift+Left history

name: Voice dictation
what: /voice enables hold-to-talk or tap-to-send dictation transcribed live into the prompt, tuned for code vocabulary.
why_for_gordon: Gordon dictates a brief for Darby while cooking; no tokens consumed for transcription.
how: /voice ; /voice tap ; "voice":{"enabled":true,"mode":"tap","autoSubmit":true} ; rebind voice:pushToTalk

name: Artifacts from the terminal
what: Claude publishes a live HTML page to claude.ai; /artifacts lists them; Ctrl+] reopens the latest.
why_for_gordon: Ship a GGP board dashboard or a class handout as a shareable page straight from a session.
how: Ask for 'an artifact that ...' ; /artifacts (o open, c copy, Enter attach) ; Ctrl+] ; CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_AUTO_OPEN=0

name: Ultra code review in the cloud
what: /code-review ultra launches a verified multi-agent review in a sandbox; claude ultrareview runs it from CI.
why_for_gordon: Pre-merge confidence on the GGP directory before a public push; three free runs on Pro and Max.
how: /code-review ultra [PR|branch] [--post] ; claude ultrareview 1234 --json --timeout 45

name: Auto memory and /memory
what: Claude keeps its own MEMORY.md index and topic files per repo; /memory browses, edits, and toggles it.
why_for_gordon: This is the mechanism behind Darby's memory directory; the 200-line index limit explains the 17KB rule.
how: /memory ; autoMemoryEnabled=false per project ; autoMemoryDirectory to relocate ; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1

name: Stream tokens to a pipe
what: stream-json plus --include-partial-messages emits newline JSON events you can filter with jq in real time.
why_for_gordon: Lets Darby relay live progress to iMessage or a status page instead of waiting for the whole answer.
how: claude -p "..." --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages | jq -rj 'select(.type=="stream_event") ...'

name: Follow subagent transcripts in the stream
what: --forward-subagent-text emits subagent text and thinking with parent_tool_use_id so you can rebuild the nesting tree.
why_for_gordon: Debugging multi-agent Darby runs (and Astra handoffs) becomes possible from a single log stream.
how: claude -p ... --output-format stream-json --forward-subagent-text (v2.1.211+), or CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT=1

name: Setup hooks with --init and --maintenance
what: Print-mode flags run Setup hooks matched to init or maintenance before the session; --init-only runs SessionStart hooks then exits.
why_for_gordon: Darby's nightly backup and index refresh can be Claude-managed maintenance passes rather than hand-rolled shell.
how: claude -p --maintenance "..."; claude --init-only

name: Reload skills and plugins without restart
what: /reload-skills rescans skill directories; /reload-plugins reloads plugins and warns before invalidating the prompt cache.
why_for_gordon: Iterate on a Darby skill mid-session without losing context.
how: /reload-skills ; /reload-plugins [--force]

name: opusplan with 1M for both phases
what: opusplan plans on Opus and executes on Sonnet; opusplan[1m] forces the 1M window through both phases.
why_for_gordon: Plan a large GGP directory refactor with Opus, execute cheaply on Sonnet, never lose context.
how: /model opusplan[1m] (v2.1.265+ for /model)

name: Session-only model switch
what: In the /model picker, press s to switch for this session without saving it as your default.
why_for_gordon: Try Fable on one hard task without changing what Darby's jobs use tomorrow.
how: /model then highlight a model and press s; Enter saves as default

name: Route every shell command through the classifier
what: autoMode.classifyAllShell suspends all Bash allow rules in auto mode so nothing slips past on a narrow prefix.
why_for_gordon: Extra safety for Darby's Mac Mini where allow rules accumulated over months.
how: {"autoMode":{"classifyAllShell":true}} (v2.1.193+)

name: Rebind keys and add chords
what: ~/.claude/keybindings.json binds namespace:action entries per context, supports chords like ctrl+k ctrl+s, hot reloads.
why_for_gordon: Darby's Mini can map one chord to stash, queue, or fast-mode toggles Gordon reaches for constantly.
how: /keybindings; {"bindings":[{"context":"Chat","bindings":{"ctrl+e":"chat:externalEditor","ctrl+u":null}}]}

name: Queue a message without interrupting
what: Ctrl+X Enter submits the draft marked to wait its turn, even when an autocomplete suggestion is highlighted.
why_for_gordon: Gordon can stack follow-ups during a long build without breaking Claude's stride.
how: Ctrl+X Enter (chat:queueSubmit, v2.1.247+); plain Enter also queues while Claude works

name: Natural-language status line generator
what: /statusline writes the script and settings for you from a plain-English description.
why_for_gordon: One line gets Darby a bar showing model, context percent, and git branch on the Mini.
how: /statusline show model name and context percentage with a progress bar

name: Timed refresh and clickable footer links
what: refreshInterval re-runs the status script every N seconds; footerLinksRegexes adds clickable badges when an ID appears.
why_for_gordon: Show a clock or Astra watcher state, and turn GGP ticket IDs into links without a script.
how: "statusLine":{"type":"command","command":"~/.claude/statusline.sh","refreshInterval":5}; footerLinksRegexes in settings

name: /config key=value shorthand
what: Set one setting without the menu, including from -p; the menu itself saves to the right file for you.
why_for_gordon: Darby can flip verbose or thinking per job in a single command.
how: /config verbose=true ; /config thinking=false ; /config workflowSizeGuideline=small

name: One-session settings override
what: --settings accepts inline JSON or a file and applies above user, project, and local files for that run only.
why_for_gordon: Try Opus or fast mode for one job without touching Darby's saved settings.
how: claude --settings '{"model":"claude-opus-4-8"}' ; claude -p --settings '{"fastMode":true}'

name: Settings hot reload and source check
what: Edits to permissions, hooks, and helpers apply to the running session; /status lists which settings files loaded.
why_for_gordon: No restart when Darby adjusts an allow rule mid-task; /status confirms it landed.
how: Edit settings.json, then /status and read the Setting sources line

name: /debug skill with log capture
what: /debug enables debug logging for the session and has Claude diagnose using the log output and settings paths.
why_for_gordon: Faster than reading ~/.claude/debug by hand when a hook or MCP server silently fails.
how: /debug <description> ; logs at ~/.claude/debug/<session-id>.txt ; claude --debug-file ./claude-debug.txt

name: Session-wide custom agent
what: --agent runs the whole session as a named subagent definition with its tools, model, and restrictions.
why_for_gordon: Launch Darby as its own agent profile per job (triage, brief, send-safety) rather than the default persona.
how: claude --agent code-reviewer ; or "agent": "..." in .claude/settings.json ; /agents now just points at .claude/agents/

name: Toggle skill visibility from /skills
what: In /skills press Space to cycle a skill between on, name-only, user-only, off; saves to settings as skillOverrides.
why_for_gordon: Hide Astra-only skills from Claude's auto-invocation while keeping them in the / menu.
how: /skills, Space to cycle, t to sort by tokens, Esc saves ; {"skillOverrides":{"deploy":"off"}}

name: Fast mode toggle
what: /fast runs Opus up to 2.5x faster at higher per-token cost from usage credits; toggle mid-turn, icon shows state.
why_for_gordon: Live debugging a site with Gordon watching; turn it off for batch jobs.
how: /fast ; Option+O ; "fastMode": true ; "fastModePerSessionOptIn": true to reset each session

name: Guided compaction
what: /compact takes focus instructions, and a Compact instructions section in CLAUDE.md steers every auto-compaction.
why_for_gordon: Keep the care ledger and send-safety rules alive through long Darby sessions.
how: /compact Focus on the roster and unsent drafts ; CLAUDE.md: # Compact instructions

name: Branch a conversation
what: /branch copies the transcript and switches you into it; --fork-session does the same from the CLI.
why_for_gordon: Try two designs for a GGP page from the same context without wrecking either.
how: /branch try-streaming-approach ; claude --continue --fork-session

name: /context shows what fills the window
what: Visualizes system prompt, tools, MCP schemas, memory files, skills, and messages so you can see what loaded.
why_for_gordon: Confirms MEMORY.md and rules actually loaded before Darby builds anything factual.
how: /context ; /context all ; ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto to load MCP schemas upfront when they fit

name: Worktree from a pull request
what: Pass a PR number or URL to --worktree and Claude Code fetches that head into .claude/worktrees/pr-<n>.
why_for_gordon: Review a contributor's GGP directory PR in isolation with one command.
how: claude --worktree "#1234" (GitLab MR URLs too, v2.1.233+)

name: Subagents in their own worktrees
what: isolation: worktree in a subagent's frontmatter gives each run a temporary worktree, swept later if unchanged.
why_for_gordon: Parallel refactor agents on the site never step on each other.
how:
---
name: refactorer
isolation: worktree
--- in .claude/agents/refactorer.md

name: Desktop CI status bar with Auto-fix and Auto-merge
what: After a PR opens, the app polls checks and offers Auto-fix, Auto-merge, and auto-archive on merge.
why_for_gordon: Hands-off PR lifecycle for GGP directory changes.
how: Toggle Auto-fix and Auto-merge in the CI status bar; Settings, Claude Code, Auto-archive after PR merge or close

name: VS Code plan review and session groups
what: Plan mode opens the plan as a Markdown doc for inline comments; sessions can be grouped; Option+K inserts @file#lines.
why_for_gordon: Comment on Darby's plan for a site before a line changes; group sessions by class or project.
how: Extension: Plan mode indicator; Option+K; right-click session to group (v2.1.229+); Session history, Web tab resumes cloud sessions

name: VS Code Focus view and /btw panel
what: Focus view hides tool activity; /btw opens a persistent side-question panel with follow-ups.
why_for_gordon: Read only the prose while a build runs; ask side questions without polluting context.
how: Ctrl+Option+F (v2.1.221+) ; /btw <question> in the prompt box (extension v2.1.227+)

name: Queue and take back messages
what: Messages typed while Claude works queue above the input; Up from the first line pulls them back to edit.
why_for_gordon: Gordon can type three thoughts during a build and reorder them before they land.
how: Type and Enter while Claude works; press Up on the first line to take back; Esc to interrupt instead

name: Shell mode that answers itself
what: ! runs a command outside Claude and Claude responds to the output automatically; Tab completes from ! history.
why_for_gordon: ! git status then Claude explains the mess in one step during Darby maintenance.
how: ! npm test ; set "respondToBashCommands": false to restore output-only (v2.1.186+)

name: Live diff panel
what: /diff opens a panel beside the conversation in fullscreen that refreshes as Claude edits; Ctrl+X B cycles the comparison base.
why_for_gordon: Watch a site rebuild file by file and select lines to ask about.
how: /diff (fullscreen, git repo, 110+ columns, v2.1.260+) ; Ctrl+X B ; select lines to attach to the next prompt

name: Session recap on return
what: After you step away, a one-line recap of the session appears; /recap generates one on demand.
why_for_gordon: Gordon returns from class and sees where Darby left off in one line.
how: /recap ; /config, Session recap to turn automatic recaps off

name: Background a running command
what: Ctrl+B moves a running Bash tool call to the background; output goes to a file Claude can read later.
why_for_gordon: Start the Pages build and keep working; Claude reads the log when it finishes.
how: Ctrl+B (twice under tmux) ; /tasks to view ; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1 to turn off

name: Interactive /init
what: With CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1, /init asks which artifacts to create, explores with a subagent, and proposes before writing.
why_for_gordon: Bootstraps a CLAUDE.md, skills, and hooks for a new CTIN course repo in one guided pass.
how: CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 claude then /init ; reads AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules, copilot-instructions

name: Advisor model
what: --advisor or /advisor consults a second model for guidance at key moments during a task.
why_for_gordon: Let Fable advise a Sonnet session on a tricky site architecture call without paying Fable for every turn.
how: claude --advisor fable ; /advisor opus ; /advisor off

name: Chrome integration flag
what: --chrome enables browser automation and testing through the Claude in Chrome extension; --no-chrome disables it per session.
why_for_gordon: Render-truth checks for Gordon's sites: click through the live page before any send.
how: claude --chrome ; /chrome to configure

name: Verify and simplify skills
what: /verify builds and runs the app to observe the result; /simplify runs four parallel review agents and applies cleanups.
why_for_gordon: Matches Gordon's rule that build assertions are not a render check; verify the actual page.
how: /verify ; /simplify [target] ; Claude no longer runs /verify on its own; invoke it yourself

name: Prompt suggestions after each turn
what: Claude Code proposes the next prompt from context; Tab accepts; also emitted in -p as prompt_suggestion events.
why_for_gordon: Speeds Gordon's iterative site tweaks; Darby can log suggested next steps.
how: Tab or Right accepts; --prompt-suggestions with -p stream-json ; promptSuggestionEnabled=false to disable

name: Emoji shortcodes and spell check
what: Type :heart: to insert emoji; an optional spellcheck setting underlines misspellings using aspell or hunspell.
why_for_gordon: Cleaner outbound iMessage drafts from the terminal; catches typos before a send.
how: Type :name: or :he then Tab ; "spellcheck": true in settings ; emojiCompletionEnabled=false to disable

name: Release notes and feature lessons
what: /release-notes opens an interactive version picker; /powerup runs animated lessons on features.
why_for_gordon: Darby's weekly reflection can diff what changed since last week, straight from the CLI.
how: /release-notes ; /powerup

name: Forked skill with agent and background
what: `context: fork` runs a skill in an isolated subagent; `agent:` picks the type and `background: false` waits for the result.
why_for_gordon: Long GGP research skills can run off to the side without flooding the main Darby conversation.
how: Frontmatter: `context: fork`, `agent: Explore`, `background: false` (v2.1.218+).

name: Dynamic context injection in skills
what: Backtick `!` commands and ```! blocks run before the skill loads and their output replaces the placeholder.
why_for_gordon: A morning-brief skill can inject `date`, calendar output, and `imsg_since.sh` results automatically.
how: Write !`date` or a ```! fenced block in SKILL.md; disable with `disableSkillShellExecution`.

name: /skill-doctor context audit
what: Reports each skill's context cost and invocation frequency and flags unused skills to switch off.
why_for_gordon: Gordon's 100-skill collection can be pruned by evidence, not guesswork.
how: Run `/skill-doctor` (v2.1.252+); also the Stats tab in `/plugin`.

name: Prompt-based hooks
what: `type: prompt` sends the event JSON to a model for a judgment call and returns ok/reason.
why_for_gordon: A model-judged Stop hook can check every Darby reply against the voice rules (no em dashes).
how: Hook handler `{"type": "prompt", "prompt": "...$ARGUMENTS"}`.

name: Plugin monitors
what: A plugin's `monitors/monitors.json` starts background watchers that push stdout lines to Claude as events.
why_for_gordon: The Astra watcher becomes a plugin monitor instead of a 2-minute launchd poll.
how: `[{"name": "astra", "command": "tail -F ...", "when": "on-skill-invoke:astra-daily"}]`.

name: claude plugin eval
what: Run a plugin against a suite of prompts with graders, with and without the plugin, and gate CI on the score.
why_for_gordon: Prove the send-safety plugin changes behavior before Darby texts anyone.
how: `claude plugin eval init`, then `claude plugin eval . --threshold 0.8 --json results.json` (v2.1.269+).

name: Subagent persistent memory
what: `memory: user|project|local` gives a custom subagent its own auto-memory directory across sessions.
why_for_gordon: A people-researcher subagent remembers guards like Jeff Royle vs Jeff Cooke.
how: Frontmatter `memory: project` in `.claude/agents/<name>.md`.

name: Fork mode default and /subtask
what: Forks inherit the full conversation and cache; `/subtask` starts one by hand; off with CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0.
why_for_gordon: Hand off a side task mid-brief without re-explaining Gordon's world.
how: `/subtask draft the Joe day card from what we discussed` (v2.1.232+).

name: Dynamic workflows and ultracode
what: Claude writes a JavaScript script that orchestrates dozens to hundreds of subagents in the background.
why_for_gordon: Sweep every one of 200 IMPACT contacts with a verifier per finding.
how: Prefix a prompt with `ultracode:` or say `use a workflow`; watch with `/workflows`.

name: /deep-research bundled workflow
what: Fans out web searches, cross-checks sources, votes on claims, returns a cited report.
why_for_gordon: Fact-check a festival bill or a board candidate before Gordon writes.
how: `/deep-research <question>`.

name: Cross-session messaging
what: Sessions on one machine discover each other with ListAgents and pass text with SendMessage.
why_for_gordon: The relay watcher session can tell the brief session when new iMessages land.
how: Ask: `Tell the session working on X that ...`; `/list-agents` shows targets (v2.1.224+).

name: Monitor tool
what: Runs a background command or WebSocket and streams each output line back as an event Claude reacts to.
why_for_gordon: Tail `latenite_watch.log` and react the moment Astra drops a file.
how: Ask `Tail X in the background and tell me when Y appears`; `ws` input for sockets (v2.1.195+).

name: Channels
what: An MCP plugin pushes external events (Telegram, Discord, iMessage) into a running session and Claude replies back.
why_for_gordon: The official iMessage channel could replace Darby's hand-rolled relay watcher.
how: `/plugin install imessage@claude-plugins-official`, then `claude --channels plugin:imessage@claude-plugins-official`.

name: Cloud routines via /schedule
what: Create a cloud routine conversationally from the CLI; runs without the Mini awake.
why_for_gordon: Darby's morning brief survives a Mini reboot.
how: `/schedule daily PR review at 9am`; `/schedule list|update|run`.

name: Artifacts from Claude Code
what: Publish an HTML or Markdown page to a private claude.ai URL that updates in place; `/artifacts` lists them.
why_for_gordon: Board dossiers and briefs as live pages, private until Gordon shares.
how: Ask `Make an artifact that ...`; `Ctrl+]` reopens; `/artifacts` (v2.1.208+).

name: Artifacts with live MCP connector data
what: A page declares connectors and each viewer's own account fetches fresh data on load.
why_for_gordon: A GGP scholar dashboard that pulls the Directory live for Alex.
how: Prompt names the connector; connector pages cannot be shared publicly (v2.1.209+).

name: /design canvas
what: Drafts a UI, poster, or flow as editable artboards on one canvas published as an artifact running Claude Design's editor.
why_for_gordon: Mock the KiKi event flyer or a 463 slide layout, then tweak by hand.
how: `/design a settings screen for a mobile banking app` (v2.1.234+).

name: Skill effort override
what: A skill's frontmatter can pin reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) for the turn it runs.
why_for_gordon: Darby's cheap routine skills (inbox triage) can run at low effort while syllabus drafting runs at max.
how: Add `effort: low` (or xhigh, max) to SKILL.md frontmatter.

name: Named skill arguments
what: Declare `arguments: issue branch` and reference `$issue` and `$branch`; `$0`, `$1`, `$ARGUMENTS[N]` also work.
why_for_gordon: A `/brief person date` skill reads clean named inputs instead of parsing one blob.
how: Frontmatter `arguments: [person, date]`, then use `$person` in the body.

name: Skill-scoped hooks with once
what: A skill can register hooks in frontmatter that stay active for the session; `once: true` removes a hook after first success.
why_for_gordon: A send-safety skill can install a PreToolUse guard the moment it is invoked.
how: Frontmatter `hooks:` map; handler field `once: true`.

name: Skill visibility controls
what: `disable-model-invocation: true` hides a skill from Claude; `user-invocable: false` hides it from the slash menu.
why_for_gordon: Keep send-to-people skills manual-only so Darby never fires them on its own.
how: Set the boolean in SKILL.md frontmatter; booleans accept yes/no/on/off (v2.1.218+).

name: skillOverrides in settings
what: Per-skill visibility from settings: on, name-only, user-invocable-only, or off, without editing the skill.
why_for_gordon: Turn down noisy third-party skills that eat Darby's context.
how: `"skillOverrides": {"deploy": "off", "research": "user-invocable-only"}` in settings.json.

name: Skill directory as plugin
what: Add `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` inside a skill folder and it loads as `<name>@skills-dir` with agents, hooks, and MCP bundled.
why_for_gordon: Package Darby's astra-daily skill with its watcher hook and MCP server as one unit.
how: `claude plugin init my-skill` scaffolds it in `~/.claude/skills/` (v2.1.246+).

name: Skill allowed-tools with variable paths
what: Pre-approve a bundled script by path: `allowed-tools: Bash(${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/render.sh *)`.
why_for_gordon: Darby's `ship.py` render check runs without a permission prompt inside the skill turn.
how: Use `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` in the allowed-tools Bash rule.

name: skill-creator evals
what: The skill-creator plugin runs `evals/evals.json` test cases in clean subagents, grades to grading.json, and benchmarks with vs without the skill.
why_for_gordon: Measure whether the send-safety skill actually triggers before trusting it with Joe's texts.
how: `/plugin install skill-creator@claude-plugins-official`, then define evals/evals.json.

name: Agent-based hooks
what: `type: agent` runs a multi-turn verifier with tools (up to 50 turns) before allowing an action.
why_for_gordon: Before a send, an agent hook can open the calendar and confirm a slot actually exists.
how: Hook handler `{"type": "agent", "prompt": "Verify...$ARGUMENTS"}` (experimental).

name: HTTP and MCP tool hooks
what: Hooks can POST event JSON to a URL or call a tool on a connected MCP server.
why_for_gordon: Darby can log every outbound message to a local audit endpoint without shell scripts.
how: `{"type": "http", "url": ...}` or `{"type": "mcp_tool", "server": ..., "tool": ...}`.

name: Hook if filter by command
what: The `if` field narrows a hook with permission-rule syntax such as `Bash(git *)` or `Edit(*.ts)`.
why_for_gordon: Run the send-safety guard only on `Bash(imsg *)` and `Bash(safe_send.py *)`.
how: Add `"if": "Bash(git *)"` to the handler.

name: FileChanged and CwdChanged hooks
what: React when a watched file changes on disk or when Claude changes directory; both can write CLAUDE_ENV_FILE.
why_for_gordon: Watch `allowFrom.json` or `care_ledger.json` and re-inject state when they change.
how: `"FileChanged": [{"matcher": ".env|allowFrom.json", ...}]` in settings.

name: StopFailure hook
what: Fires when a turn ends on an API error, with matchers like rate_limit, overloaded, billing_error.
why_for_gordon: Darby's scheduled brief can alert Gordon by iMessage when a run dies on a quota.
how: `"StopFailure": [{"matcher": "rate_limit|overloaded", ...}]`.

name: Protected-files PreToolUse hook
what: A script reads tool_input.file_path and exits 2 to block edits to protected paths.
why_for_gordon: Guard `allowFrom.json`, `.env`, and the care ledger from accidental rewrites.
how: `.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh` under `PreToolUse` matcher `Edit|Write`.

name: requiresUserInteraction tool annotation
what: A server marks a tool so it prompts on every call, even in auto or bypass modes.
why_for_gordon: Any tool that texts a person should carry this so no mode can auto-fire it.
how: `"_meta": {"anthropic/requiresUserInteraction": true}` on the tool.

name: Claude.ai connectors in Claude Code
what: Connectors from the claude.ai account (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) appear automatically; toggle in /mcp.
why_for_gordon: Darby reads gbellamy's calendar through the same connector Gordon uses on his phone.
how: Manage at claude.ai/customize/connectors; disable with `disabledMcpServers`.

name: Plugin bin on PATH
what: Executables in a plugin's `bin/` join the Bash tool PATH while the plugin is enabled.
why_for_gordon: Ship `dsend`, `ship.py`, and `verify_send` as one Darby toolkit plugin.
how: Put scripts in `<plugin>/bin/`; not allowed for claude.ai org distribution.

name: Plugin default settings and main agent
what: A plugin's `settings.json` can set `agent` to make one of its agents the main thread.
why_for_gordon: A `gordon-voice` plugin can make Darby always run as the Gordon-voice agent.
how: `{"agent": "security-reviewer"}` in the plugin root settings.json.

name: Eval graders and MCP mocks
what: Graders: regex, tool_used, tool_order, file_exists, llm, baseline; MCP tools answer from `evals/mocks/<server>/<tool>.md`.
why_for_gordon: Test the imsg send path with a mocked iMessage server, nothing real fires.
how: Write `graders` in case.yaml; mock files with `{{input.field}}` and `expect:` blocks.

name: Code intelligence LSP plugins
what: Install `typescript-lsp`, `pyright-lsp`, etc. and Claude gets live diagnostics after edits plus symbol navigation.
why_for_gordon: Phaser and Node gamelab edits get type errors immediately.
how: `/plugin install typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official` with the binary on PATH.

name: Worktree isolation for subagents
what: `isolation: worktree` runs a subagent in a temporary git worktree with Bash confined there.
why_for_gordon: Let an experimental site rebuild run without touching the live Pages checkout.
how: Frontmatter `isolation: worktree`; auto-cleanup if unchanged.

name: Background subagents by default
what: Subagents run concurrently and return a completion notice; pin with `background: true|false`.
why_for_gordon: Darby keeps triaging while a research subagent digs.
how: Frontmatter `background: true`; `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1` forces foreground.

name: Resume subagents with SendMessage
what: Message a finished subagent by ID or name to continue with its full history and warm cache.
why_for_gordon: Ask the roster-checker to verify one more name instead of restarting.
how: Prompt: `Resume the code-reviewer subagent and ...`; Explore and Plan are one-shot.

name: Subagent-scoped MCP servers and skills
what: `mcpServers:` and `skills:` frontmatter preload skills and scope servers to one subagent.
why_for_gordon: A calendar subagent gets only the Calendar connector and the never-offer-unread skill.
how: Frontmatter `skills: [brain-recall]`, `mcpServers: {...}`.

name: Run a session as an agent
what: `claude --agent <name>` or `"agent"` in settings makes a custom agent the main thread.
why_for_gordon: Start Darby as the gordon-voice agent every time.
how: `claude --agent gordon-voice` or `{"agent": "gordon-voice"}` in settings.json.

name: Save a workflow as a command
what: Press `s` in /workflows to save the script to `.claude/workflows/` or `~/.claude/workflows/`; runs as `/<name>`.
why_for_gordon: The weekly reflection becomes a rerunnable `/weekly-reflect` orchestration.
how: `/workflows`, select run, `s`; edit the `.js` after loading `/workflow-authoring`.

name: Workflow script API
what: `agent()`, `pipeline()`, `parallel()`, `phase()`, `log()`, `args`; `schema` returns typed JSON from a subagent.
why_for_gordon: Structured JSON out of each people-lookup agent feeds a roster table.
how: `const r = await agent(prompt, {schema: {...}})`; `pipeline(items, fn)`.

name: @-mention a session
what: Type `@` plus a session name to address a message directly, skipping the listing step.
why_for_gordon: `Let @relay know the gateway is back`.
how: `@api-worker` or `@"release notes"` in the prompt (v2.1.232+).

name: notify_when_idle
what: Ask another local session to send one notice when it next goes idle or exits.
why_for_gordon: Darby waits on a long export job in another session without polling.
how: Prompt: `Tell me when the migration session finishes` (v2.1.236+).

name: Post into a session socket from a script
what: Hooks and scripts can write to `$CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET` with an optional auth token line.
why_for_gordon: The launchd watcher can push a line straight into a running Darby session.
how: Connect to the Unix socket, send `{"type":"auth","token":"$CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN"}` then the message.

name: /goal completion loop
what: Set a condition and a small model re-evaluates after each turn until met, impossible, or cleared.
why_for_gordon: `/goal every 463 speaker has a confirmed date in the single source`.
how: `/goal <condition>`, `/goal clear`; works with `claude -p`.

name: /loop self-paced and loop.md
what: Omit the interval and Claude picks the next wait; a `loop.md` replaces the maintenance prompt.
why_for_gordon: A session-scoped Astra check that slows down when nothing is pending.
how: `/loop check Astra's inbox`; `.claude/loop.md` for the default prompt.

name: Claude in Chrome from the CLI
what: `claude --chrome` drives the signed-in browser: navigate, click, forms, console, network, GIF recording.
why_for_gordon: Fill USC forms and read Monday boards without an API.
how: `claude --chrome`; `/chrome` for status, default-on, and browser selection.

name: Routine API and GitHub triggers
what: POST to a per-routine `/fire` endpoint with a bearer token, or fire on pull_request or release events.
why_for_gordon: An Xsolla or Directory webhook can wake a GGP routine.
how: `curl -X POST .../routines/<id>/fire -H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` with `text` payload.

name: Desktop scheduled tasks
what: Local recurring tasks with file access, per-task permission mode, worktree isolation, and one catch-up run after sleep.
why_for_gordon: Local jobs that need chat.db and the Mini's files, unlike cloud routines.
how: Code tab, Routines, New routine, Local; prompt lives in `~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/<name>/SKILL.md`.

name: .claude/rules with paths frontmatter
what: Split instructions into topic files; `paths:` globs load a rule only when matching files are touched.
why_for_gordon: Site playbook rules load only for `*.html`; messaging rules for `bin/*send*`.
how: `.claude/rules/site.md` with `paths: ["sites/**/*.html"]`.

name: Auto memory MEMORY.md index limits
what: First 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md load each session; topic files load on demand; `modified` timestamps added.
why_for_gordon: Explains the keep-index-under-17KB rule; frontmatter timestamps show fact freshness.
how: `/memory` to browse; `autoMemoryDirectory` to relocate; `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1`.

name: CLAUDE.md imports and AGENTS.md bridge
what: `@path` imports (4 hops deep) and `@AGENTS.md` share instructions with other agents.
why_for_gordon: One AGENTS.md serves Darby and Astra (Codex) at once.
how: Write `@AGENTS.md` at the top of CLAUDE.md, or `ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md`.

name: /import other agents' config
what: Bring AGENTS.md, MCP servers, commands, and skills from Codex, Gemini, or Cursor into Claude Code.
why_for_gordon: Import whatever Astra has built on the Codex side in one step.
how: `/import codex --dry-run` (v2.1.213+; Cursor v2.1.265+).

name: Extension trigger table
what: Decision rules: twice-wrong goes to CLAUDE.md, repeated prompt becomes a skill, must-always-happen becomes a hook.
why_for_gordon: A rubric for where each of Gordon's feedback rules should actually live.
how: Follow the Build your setup over time table; put guardrails in hooks, not prose.

name: Artifact comments Claude answers
what: Org viewers comment; Send to Claude or @claude activates a thread and the session replies or edits on its own.
why_for_gordon: Alex leaves notes on the Directory page and Darby fixes them.
how: Share within org; `/tasks` shows the live-updates watch (v2.1.221+, auto-reply v2.1.228+).

name: Design tokens in CLAUDE.md for artifacts
what: Record colors, fonts, and spacing in CLAUDE.md and Claude's design skill uses them above its own picks.
why_for_gordon: GGP brand consistency across every published page.
how: Add a `## Design system` block to CLAUDE.md (v2.1.182+).

name: Path-scoped skill activation
what: The `paths` frontmatter field limits when Claude auto-loads a skill to files matching globs.
why_for_gordon: Site-building skills fire only when Gordon works in the GGP directory or Pages repo.
how: Frontmatter `paths: ["sites/**", "*.html"]`.

name: Skills synced from claude.ai
what: Skills enabled on the claude.ai account download to `~/.claude/skills/synced/` in `-p` mode.
why_for_gordon: Darby's launchd jobs can reach skills Gordon curates in the Claude app without copying files.
how: `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS=1 claude -p "..."` (v2.1.228+).

name: Session naming for messaging
what: `claude -n name` or `/rename` gives sessions stable names other sessions address; duplicates get a suffix.
why_for_gordon: Name the relay, brief, and Astra sessions so they can find each other.
how: `claude -n relay-watcher`; `/rename astra-daily` (v2.1.232+ uniqueness).

name: Anthropic skills repo and template
what: github.com/anthropics/skills ships example skills, the spec, and a template folder for new skills.
why_for_gordon: Fast starting point for CTIN course-material skills (docx, pptx, xlsx included).
how: Clone the repo; copy `template/` and edit SKILL.md.

name: PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch hooks
what: Block or react to model changes by canonical model name matcher.
why_for_gordon: Stop launchd jobs from silently landing on an expensive model.
how: Match `claude-opus-5` or `.*opus.*` under `PreModelSwitch`; return permissionDecision.

name: InstructionsLoaded and ConfigChange hooks
what: Log which CLAUDE.md or rules loaded and why; block or audit settings changes mid-session.
why_for_gordon: Debug why a path-scoped rule never fired in the memory index.
how: Matchers: session_start, path_glob_match, include; ConfigChange: user_settings, skills.

name: Async hooks with asyncRewake
what: `async: true` lets a hook run without blocking; `asyncRewake` wakes Claude when it finishes.
why_for_gordon: Fire the nightly backup script from SessionEnd without stalling exit.
how: Handler fields `"async": true, "asyncRewake": true`.

name: Notification hook for attention
what: Fire a desktop notification whenever Claude waits for input or permission.
why_for_gordon: Gordon hears the Mini when Darby is blocked instead of finding it hours later.
how: `Notification` hook with `osascript -e 'display notification ...'`.

name: MessageDisplay hook
what: Transform or hide assistant text as it streams, display only.
why_for_gordon: Lint Gordon's voice rules (spelling, em dashes) at render time.
how: `"MessageDisplay": [...]` with a 10s default timeout.

name: SessionStart reloadSkills
what: A SessionStart hook can return `reloadSkills: true` so skills it installs load in the same session.
why_for_gordon: A bootstrap hook can pull Astra's newest skill files and expose them immediately.
how: Return `{"reloadSkills": true}` from the SessionStart hook.

name: headersHelper for dynamic auth
what: A command mints fresh headers for an HTTP MCP server at connect time.
why_for_gordon: Rotate short-lived tokens for a Monday.com or Xsolla bridge without editing config.
how: `"headersHelper": "/opt/bin/get-mcp-auth-headers.sh"` in the server entry.

name: claude mcp login from the shell
what: Authenticate an OAuth MCP server without opening the TUI.
why_for_gordon: Launchd jobs can pre-authenticate connectors before Darby's 9am run.
how: `claude mcp login sentry [--no-browser]` (v2.1.186+).

name: Strict MCP config
what: Ignore every configured server except those passed on the command line.
why_for_gordon: Run an isolated agent-to-agent job with only the Astra bridge server loaded.
how: `claude --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config servers.json`.

name: MCP output limits per tool
what: Servers set `_meta.anthropic/maxResultSizeChars`; users raise the global cap with MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS.
why_for_gordon: Pull a full 428k-message export slice without truncation.
how: `export MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS=50000`; server annotation up to 500k chars.

name: MCP auto-backgrounding
what: Tool calls over two minutes move to a background task so the session stays usable.
why_for_gordon: Long chat.db scans no longer freeze Darby.
how: `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS=120000` (0 disables).

name: Claude Code as MCP server
what: Expose Claude Code's tools to Claude Desktop or another client.
why_for_gordon: Let Astra or Claude Desktop drive Darby's toolset directly.
how: `claude mcp serve`, then register the stdio command in the client.

name: MCP resources and prompts as commands
what: Reference server resources with `@server:uri` and run server prompts as `/mcp__server__prompt`.
why_for_gordon: Pull a Google Doc by reference into a brief; run a saved prompt from the Directory server.
how: Type `@` to browse resources; slash menu lists MCP prompts.

name: --plugin-dir folders and zip archives
what: Load a plugin folder, a folder of plugins, or a `.zip`; `--plugin-url` fetches a hosted archive.
why_for_gordon: Test Darby's plugin set in one command before committing.
how: `claude --plugin-dir ./plugins` (folder, v2.1.265+) or `--plugin-url https://...zip`.

name: Eval report published as artifact
what: Each run writes report.html and, on a claude.ai login, publishes it as a private artifact.
why_for_gordon: Share a skill's pass rate with Alex or Brennan as a link.
how: `claude plugin eval .` prints `Published: <url>`; `--no-publish` keeps it local.

name: Marketplace command and archive sources
what: Plugins can come from a local command that prints a directory or from a zip with a SHA-256 pin.
why_for_gordon: Distribute Darby tooling to the GGP Mini fleet without git or npm.
how: `"source": {"source": "archive", "url": ..., "sha256": ...}` (v2.1.224+) or `"source": "command"` (v2.1.229+).

name: Team marketplaces via settings
what: `extraKnownMarketplaces` and `enabledPlugins` in `.claude/settings.json` auto-register a catalog for a repo.
why_for_gordon: Every GGP repo can pull the same Claude Corps plugin set on trust.
how: `{"extraKnownMarketplaces": {"ggp": {"source": {"source": "github", "repo": "org/plugins"}}}}`.

name: Plugin dependencies and bundles
what: `dependencies` with semver ranges; a manifest of only dependencies installs a curated set in one command.
why_for_gordon: One `darby-standard` bundle installs everything Darby needs on a new Mini.
how: `"dependencies": ["audit-logger", {"name": "secrets-vault", "version": "~2.1.0"}]`; tag with `claude plugin tag --push`.

name: Plugin relevance suggestions
what: Marketplace entries carry a `relevance` block (cwd, cli, hosts, filesRead, manifestDeps) so Claude suggests the plugin in context.
why_for_gordon: Suggest the site-playbook plugin whenever Gordon opens a Pages repo.
how: Add `"relevance": {"topic": ..., "signals": {"filesRead": ["**/*.html"]}}`; allowlist via `pluginSuggestionMarketplaces`.

name: Plugin install activates live
what: Installs from /plugin activate in-session when cache-safe; `/reload-plugins --force` otherwise, also in `-p` mode.
why_for_gordon: No more restarting Darby after adding a plugin.
how: `/plugin install x@marketplace` then `/reload-plugins --force` if prompted (v2.1.221+, -p v2.1.260+).

name: Security guidance plugin
what: Reviews each edit for vulnerabilities, model review per turn, deeper review on commit or push.
why_for_gordon: Public GGP sites should not leak keys or XSS.
how: `/plugin install security-guidance@claude-plugins-official`; rules in `.claude/claude-security-guidance.md`.

name: Agent parameter deny rules
what: Deny or ask rules match tool inputs, e.g. `Agent(model:opus)` or `Agent(isolation:*)`.
why_for_gordon: Keep Darby's spawned agents off Opus during cheap routine runs.
how: `"deny": ["Agent(model:opus)"]` in permissions (v2.1.178+).

name: Subagent model and concurrency env vars
what: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL(_FORCE), MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS, MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH tune the fleet.
why_for_gordon: Cap spend when a workflow fans out on the flat-rate CLI.
how: `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1`.

name: Workflow size guideline and resume
what: `workflowSizeGuideline` (small to unrestricted) bounds agent count; paused runs resume from saved results.
why_for_gordon: Keep GGP research runs to under 5 agents on a budget.
how: `/config workflowSizeGuideline=small`; `p` in /workflows to pause or resume.

name: Inbound message controls
what: `crossSessionInbound` accept, hold, or refuse; `isolatePeerMachines` requires approval for cross-machine sends.
why_for_gordon: Lock Darby's sending session so nothing from Astra's side can inject.
how: `"crossSessionInbound": "hold"`, `"isolatePeerMachines": true` in settings.

name: Background Bash with auto-backgrounding
what: `run_in_background: true` or a timeout moves a command to a task; manage with /tasks.
why_for_gordon: Long `brain query` or backup jobs stop blocking Darby's turn.
how: Timeout output says `moved to the background` with a task ID and output file path.

name: Agent teams
what: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 lets a lead spawn named teammates with a shared task list and mailbox.
why_for_gordon: Five hypotheses on why the gateway died, argued adversarially.
how: Set the env var; prompt `Spawn 3 teammates to ...`; hooks TeammateIdle, TaskCompleted.

name: In-session cron tools
what: CronCreate, CronList, CronDelete schedule prompts with 5-field cron; one-shot reminders in natural language.
why_for_gordon: `remind me at 3pm to text Joe back` inside a working session.
how: Ask in natural language; tasks expire after 7 days; `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON=1` disables.

name: Chrome file uploads and disk screenshots
what: Attach local files (10 MB total) to upload fields; `save_to_disk` writes screenshots.
why_for_gordon: Upload a syllabus PDF to Brightspace or a headshot to a speaker form.
how: Ask `attach logs/session.log to the issue`; requires v2.1.211+.

name: Chrome read-only calls in plan mode
what: read_page, get_page_text, find, console, network, and screenshots run without prompts in plan mode.
why_for_gordon: Scout a venue site safely before Darby is allowed to act.
how: Enter plan mode, then browse; `browser_batch` prompts only if any action mutates.

name: One-off routine runs
what: Natural-language one-time cloud runs that do not count against the daily cap.
why_for_gordon: `/schedule Nov 1 at 8am, send the Jadeja Sugar Series reminder draft`.
how: `/schedule tomorrow at 9am, summarize yesterday's merged PRs`.

name: Routine run history from the CLI
what: Ask why a routine did nothing and Claude reads the run log and explains.
why_for_gordon: Debug the 9am Astra exchange without opening a browser.
how: `/schedule why did my nightly review do nothing this morning?` (v2.1.227+).

name: New /init flow
what: CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 makes /init propose CLAUDE.md, skills, and hooks after exploring with a subagent.
why_for_gordon: Bootstrap a new GGP repo's Claude setup properly.
how: `CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 claude` then `/init`.

name: Artifact editor role and update by URL
what: Team plans grant editor role; any session can update an artifact by pasting its URL.
why_for_gordon: Brennan can republish the chief-of-staff board from his own session.
how: `Update https://claude.ai/code/artifact/<id> with today's numbers`.

name: Artifact file downloads capability
what: A declared downloads capability lets viewers save a CSV or PNG the page generates; plain links are blocked.
why_for_gordon: Export a roster from a directory page.
how: Ask `Add a button that downloads this table as a CSV`.

name: /design-sync design system
what: Convert a React design system and upload it to Claude Design after `/design-login`.
why_for_gordon: Feed the GGP component library into the canvas.
how: `/design-login` then `/design-sync [hint]`.

name: Artifact page constraints
what: Single page, 16 MiB, CSP allows only Google Fonts and four CDN hosts; images as data URIs.
why_for_gordon: Explains why Pages, not artifact links, for public sites; artifacts for private review.
how: Load libraries from cdnjs or jsDelivr `/npm/`; inline everything else.

name: Claude Fable 5.1 as the frontier model
what: Fable 5.1 (Sep 1, 2026) is Anthropic's most capable released model: 1M context, 128K output, always-on adaptive thinking.
why_for_gordon: Darby's hardest jobs, like the full corpus sweeps and multi-hour research, now have a model built for long-horizon agentic work.
how: model='claude-fable-5-1'; omit thinking (always adaptive); tune output_config.effort

name: Effort ladder low, medium, high, xhigh, max
what: output_config.effort trades thoroughness for cost across all output tokens; default is high; xhigh is the coding sweet spot on Opus 4.8.
why_for_gordon: Lets Darby run routine triage at low and reserve xhigh for CTIN 463 syllabus drafting or code.
how: output_config={'effort':'medium'} on messages.create; no beta header

name: Change effort mid-conversation without a cache reset
what: On Fable 5.1, Mythos 5.1, and Opus 5, an empty system message carrying output_config.effort changes effort from the next turn while preserving the cache.
why_for_gordon: A Darby session can drop to low for a summary step and back to high for the hard step without paying the cache twice.
how: messages.append({'role':'system','content':[],'output_config':{'effort':'low'}}); betas=['mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01']

name: Structured outputs with output_config.format
what: Constrain responses to a JSON schema via output_config.format type json_schema; the old output_format parameter is deprecated.
why_for_gordon: Darby's calendar and roster extractions become guaranteed-parseable instead of regex-scraped.
how: output_config={'format':{'type':'json_schema','schema':{...,'additionalProperties':False}}}

name: SDK tool runner runs the agent loop
what: Define tools with @beta_tool or betaZodTool and the runner executes them, manages history, and loops until done, with max_iterations and per-turn takeover.
why_for_gordon: Darby's small agents lose their hand-written while loops; one decorator per tool.
how: runner = client.beta.messages.tool_runner(model=..., tools=[fn], max_iterations=10); runner.until_done()

name: Top-level automatic prompt caching
what: Put cache_control at the request top level and the breakpoint moves forward automatically as the conversation grows; up to 4 explicit breakpoints.
why_for_gordon: Darby's long chats hit cache without hand-placing breakpoints; minimum 512 tokens on 5-family models.
how: client.messages.create(cache_control={'type':'ephemeral'}, system=..., messages=...)

name: Server-side compaction for endless conversations
what: compact_20260112 summarizes earlier context at a trigger (default 150K tokens), returns a compaction block you replay; pause_after_compaction and custom instructions available.
why_for_gordon: Darby's multi-day threads can run past 1M tokens without client-side summarization code.
how: betas=['compact-2026-01-12']; context_management={'edits':[{'type':'compact_20260112','trigger':{'type':'input_tokens','value':100000}}]}; append full response.content

name: Agent SDK: query() for one-shots, ClaudeSDKClient for conversations
what: The Python Agent SDK wraps the Claude Code harness; query() streams one task, ClaudeSDKClient keeps a session with interrupts and follow-ups.
why_for_gordon: Darby's Astra collaboration can run as an SDK session on the Mini with the same tools Claude Code has.
how: pip install claude-agent-sdk; async for m in query(prompt, options=ClaudeAgentOptions(allowed_tools=[...]))

name: Scheduled deployments: cron for agents
what: Attach a cron expression and timezone to an agent; each fire starts a session with initial_events; runs are recorded; pause, unpause, archive.
why_for_gordon: The 9am Astra exchange and the morning brief could run in Anthropic's cloud rather than launchd.
how: client.beta.deployments.create(agent=id, environment_id=env, initial_events=[...], schedule={'type':'cron','expression':'0 9 * * *','timezone':'America/Los_Angeles'})

name: Vault credentials substituted at egress
what: environment_variable credentials show the sandbox only a placeholder; the real secret is injected at the network edge for allowed hosts and locations.
why_for_gordon: Darby's Gmail or calendar keys never sit in an agent's context, even under prompt injection.
how: client.beta.vaults.credentials.create(vault_id, auth={'type':'environment_variable','secret_name':'X','secret_value':..., 'networking':{'type':'limited','allowed_hosts':[...]},'injection_location':{'header':True}})

name: Self-hosted sandboxes with the environment worker
what: config type self_hosted keeps tool execution and files on your machine while Anthropic runs orchestration; SDK EnvironmentWorker or ant beta:worker polls.
why_for_gordon: The Mac Mini itself can be the sandbox, so chat.db and local scripts stay local while the loop runs in the cloud.
how: EnvironmentWorker(client, environment_id=..., environment_key=..., workdir='/workspace', tools=lambda env:[*beta_agent_toolset_20260401(env), my_tool]).run()

name: Start with Opus 5, escalate to Fable 5.1 only when evals fall short
what: Anthropic's model matrix says most workloads start on Opus 5; move to Fable 5.1 when xhigh or max effort still underperforms.
why_for_gordon: Gives Darby a default routing rule: Opus 5 for daily ops, Fable 5.1 reserved for the hard tail.
how: model='claude-opus-5' default; run evals; switch to claude-fable-5-1 for the failing tail

name: Fable 5.1 cache reads at $0.25 per MTok
what: Cache hits on Fable 5.1 cost 0.025x base input, a quarter of Fable 5's rate, so long agent sessions re-read cheaply.
why_for_gordon: Long Darby sessions that re-read a big system prompt and memory index become affordable on the top model.
how: cache_control={'type':'ephemeral'} on Fable 5.1; verify usage.cache_read_input_tokens

name: Preserved thinking: keep conversation history append-only
what: Fable 5.1 thinking blocks are bound to model and prefix; editing earlier turns invalidates them, enforced for accounts created after Aug 31, 2026.
why_for_gordon: Darby's harnesses must stop injecting and deleting reminders; use turn-scoped system messages instead.
how: betas=['thinking-binding-controls-2026-08-01']; thinking.block_binding.prefix_mismatch_behavior='drop_block'; log input_transformations

name: Server-side fallbacks with default mode
what: Pass fallbacks='default' so refused Fable or Opus 5 requests are retried automatically on Anthropic's recommended model per category.
why_for_gordon: Keeps Darby's overnight runs from stalling on a classifier refusal; the alternative arrives without human help.
how: betas=['server-side-fallback-2026-07-01']; fallbacks='default' on client.beta.messages.create

name: Compare models on cost per completed task, not per token
what: Measured: Fable 5.1 at low effort solves 11 more SWE-bench Pro points than Sonnet 5 default for 35% less cost.
why_for_gordon: Tells Darby the newest model at low effort often beats an older cheap model; measure the hard tail.
how: Baseline each effort level on a task sample; plot accuracy vs cost; pick on cost per solved task

name: Adaptive thinking is the one mode on Claude 5 models
what: budget_tokens and thinking disabled return 400 on Fable 5.x, Sonnet 5, Opus 5 at xhigh or max; omit thinking or pass adaptive.
why_for_gordon: Removes a whole class of Darby config bugs; effort is now the single knob.
how: thinking={'type':'adaptive'} or omit; control depth with output_config.effort

name: Progress updates between tool calls with display updates
what: Fable 5.x writes short status notes before tool calls; display 'updates' returns them as text while hiding reasoning.
why_for_gordon: Darby's long agent runs can stream a status line to chat 9 instead of looking silent for minutes.
how: betas=['thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18']; thinking={'type':'adaptive','display':'updates'}; render non-empty thinking blocks

name: Run everything at low effort, re-run failures at high
what: When outputs are checkable, low effort plus a high-effort retry on failures reached 91.7% pass at half the cost.
why_for_gordon: GGP directory enrichment and syllabus checks with verifiable outputs can halve API spend.
how: First pass effort='low'; validate; re-run failed items with effort='high'

name: Task budgets for agentic loops
what: Give Claude an advisory token budget for a whole agentic turn; it sees a countdown and finishes gracefully; minimum 20,000.
why_for_gordon: Darby's unattended overnight jobs get a ceiling that ends with a summary rather than a truncated action.
how: betas=['task-budgets-2026-03-13']; output_config={'task_budget':{'type':'tokens','total':64000}}; use stream()

name: Mid-conversation system messages
what: Append role 'system' messages inside messages to add operator instructions without invalidating the cached prefix (Opus 4.8, Opus 5, Fable 5.x).
why_for_gordon: Darby can inject a new house rule mid-session, and it carries system authority instead of looking like user text.

name: Turn-scoped system messages with clear_at
what: Set clear_at 'next_user_message' so a system reminder applies to one turn, then stops rendering and costs no input tokens.
why_for_gordon: Perfect for Darby's per-turn nudges like check the inbox before running more code, without breaking preserved thinking.

how: Read the refusal, retry on Opus 4.8 or Opus 5, use fallback credit per the guide

name: Recount tokens for the new tokenizer

how: client.messages.count_tokens(model='claude-fable-5-1', messages=...) and compare with the old model

name: thinking.display summarized versus omitted
what: display defaults to omitted on 5-family models; set summarized to receive readable reasoning summaries; raw chain of thought is never returned.

how: messages.append({'role':'assistant','content':response.content}) then append tool_result blocks

name: Fast mode for Opus 5 and Opus 4.8

how: client.beta.messages.create(speed='fast', betas=['fast-mode-2026-02-01']); check usage.speed

how: betas=['mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01']; follow the mid-conversation system messages guide for tool change blocks

name: Sampling parameters and prefill are gone on 5-family models

how: Delete temperature/top_p/top_k; replace prefill with output_config.format or system instructions

name: Parallel tool use, one user message of results
what: Claude may emit several tool_use blocks per turn; return all tool_result blocks in a single user message, or use disable_parallel_tool_use.
why_for_gordon: Darby's fan-out lookups across chat.db and calendar stay parallel only if results are returned together.
how: tool_choice={'type':'auto','disable_parallel_tool_use':True} to force one call; else batch results

name: Code execution is free alongside web search or fetch
what: With web_search_20260209 or web_fetch_20260209 in the request, code execution costs nothing beyond tokens; otherwise 1,550 free hours per month.
why_for_gordon: Darby's research runs get dynamic filtering and analysis without a separate execution bill.
how: Include the 2026 web tool version; monitor usage.server_tool_use.code_execution_requests

name: Web search domain filters, location, and error handling
what: allowed_domains or blocked_domains (not both), user_location, max_uses; $10 per 1,000 searches; errors return 200 with an error object; pause_turn resumes.
why_for_gordon: Darby can pin festival lookups to official lineup sites and handle max_uses_exceeded without crashing.
how: web_search tool with allowed_domains=[...], max_uses=5; branch on result.content being a list or an error object

name: Client-side MCP helpers for local stdio servers
what: SDK helpers convert MCP tools, prompts, and resources into Claude API types so local servers work with the tool runner.
